description:
Get druggability/tractability predictions for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_tractability — one record = one tractability bucket of one modality for one gene.
Key: id, tractability[].modality, tractability[].id.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: one row = one item (one tractability bucket of one modality for one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Open Targets tractability buckets; a gene with no buckets was not assessed.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
